top_jobs.job: When I catch myself scrolling rival sites and Instagram at night, help me see only the rival moves that touch our sales this week, like a sale, a launch, a new policy or a stock out, so I can act on those and stop watching the rest
top_jobs.metric: rival moves flagged per week with our sales touched in dollars

top_jobs.job: When our creative team runs dry, help me see how rivals spread their ads across awareness levels and which angles they keep paying for, turned into principles we can test in our own words, so we reach new buyers without copying anyone
top_jobs.metric: tests launched from rival principles each month and their hit rate

top_jobs.job: When shoppers compare us with a named rival and some leave for them, help me learn from rival reviews and lost buyers what they fail at and what they win on, so we pitch against their weakness with proof
top_jobs.metric: conversion rate of chats and pages where a rival is named

top_jobs.job: When I set prices or plan a sale, help me see where our price and discounts sit against rivals per unit and when they run their big sales, so we are not priced out, not training buyers to wait and not drowned out
top_jobs.metric: our price per unit against the rival median, per product

top_jobs.job: When I set next quarter's budget, help me see how loud we are next to rivals in ads, brand search and Amazon, and who is growing faster, so I know if we are being outshouted or paying a toll on our own name
top_jobs.metric: our share of active ads and of brand search impressions

jobs.job: Set up the rival list: 5 to 8 rivals with Meta page ids, social handles, site URLs and Amazon listings, plus 2 substitutes buyers use instead, and have the founder confirm it
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, reviewed each quarter

inputs.need: brands running ads on our category terms
brands bidding on our brand name
rivals named in reviews and chats

steps: List rivals from the founder, the Ad Library, auction insights and reviews
Find page ids, handles, site URLs and Amazon listings for each
Add 2 substitutes: what buyers do instead
Founder confirms 5 to 8 rivals and ranks the top 3
File on the competitors shelf and start the weekly pulls
jobs.output: a confirmed rival list with ids, handles, URLs and a top 3
jobs.next: feeds every job on this screen and 09 creative

watch.metric: rivals with a working weekly pull

jobs.drives: a clean base for every rival read

jobs.job: Send a Monday rival digest with only the moves that touch our products making over 10 percent of sales: price, offer, shipping, returns, new products
steps: Pull last week's diffs and new ads
Match each move to our products
Drop moves on products under 10 percent of our sales
Rank the rest by our sales touched in dollars
Write 1 line each with a respond, watch or ignore call
jobs.output: a Monday digest of 3 to 7 moves with dollars touched and a call each
jobs.next: feeds 04-20 (answer a rival sale) and 00 Today

watch.metric: hours from a rival move to our call

jobs.drives: founder peace of mind and fewer missed moves

jobs.job: Alert the same day a rival starts a sale, with the share of our sales it touches and 3 choices: match, hold or answer with value
steps: Spot a new sale banner, price cut or sale ad
Match to our products and compute our sales touched
Cost match, hold and answer with value using margin per order
Send the 3 choices to the founder
Log the call and read our sales for 7 days after
jobs.output: a same day alert with 3 costed choices and a logged call
jobs.next: feeds 04-20 (answer without matching)

watch.metric: our sales on touched products during rival sales

jobs.job: Flag when a rival is weak, out of stock on a best seller, pulling ads or in bad press, and propose a push to win their buyers that week
jobs.trigger: weekly, and on a stock out or a drop in rival ads

inputs.need: rival active ad count by week
news and review spikes about rivals

steps: Check rival stock on their top 10 products
Check rival active ads against their 8 week average
Check news and rival review spikes
If weak, propose a push: budget up, a comparison ad, a search campaign on their name
Founder approves and the push runs for 2 weeks
jobs.output: a weak rival flag with a 2 week push plan
jobs.next: feeds 11 paid social and 12 Google ads

watch.metric: new customers during the push

jobs.job: Tag every rival ad and every one of our ads by awareness level (unaware, problem aware, solution aware, product aware, most aware), weight rival ads by run length and variant count, and show our share next to 3 rivals
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then every Monday after the ad pull

inputs.need: last 90 days of our ads with spend and purchases
active and past ads of 3 to 5 rivals
inputs.from: Meta Ad Library by page id

inputs.need: awareness rubric with 5 examples per level

steps: Pull our ads and rivals' ads
Tag each with 1 awareness level and 1 funnel stage using the rubric
Check 20 tags by hand and fix the rubric
Weight ours by spend; weight rivals by days live times variant count, since their spend is hidden
Lay the 5 levels by 4 brands as a heat map
Write the gap: the level where we are thin and rivals are thick
jobs.output: a heat map of 5 awareness levels by 4 brands, with the gap line
jobs.next: feeds 03-06 (fill the gap) and 09 creative briefs

watch.metric: our share of spend on unaware and problem aware ads

jobs.job: For the awareness level where rivals push and we are thin, pull 10 examples from rivals and the swipe file, and write 3 briefs for our own ads at that level
jobs.trigger: after each heat map update that shows a gap
steps: Filter rival ads and the swipe file by the thin level
Pick 10 that ran 30 days or more
Write the principle each follows in 1 line
Write 3 briefs in our voice for our avatar, never copying text, logos, products or faces
Send to creative as 1 test
jobs.output: 3 briefs at the thin awareness level with the principles behind them
jobs.next: feeds 09 creative and 11 paid social test

watch.metric: cost per new customer for ads at the new level

jobs.job: Turn rival ads and posts that ran 30 days or more into principles: what they do, why it likely works, and the test to run in our own words

inputs.need: idea bank and knowledge cards to check principles against

steps: Pull rival ads live 30 days or more and posts with 3 times the account's median views
Tag hook, angle, format, proof and awareness level
Match each to a principle in the idea bank or cards
Write 1 line why it likely works and 1 test for us
Mark each as a signal, not a proven winner
File in the swipe file with the note
jobs.output: a list of principles, each with the rival examples, a why line and a test
jobs.next: feeds 09 creative (scripts and briefs) and 10 copy

watch.metric: hit rate of tests built from rival principles

jobs.job: Pull each rival's top organic posts from the last 90 days on TikTok and Instagram, tag hook and format, and name the formats that get 3 times their usual views

inputs.need: public posts with views and dates
a social data tool for view history

steps: Pull 90 days of posts per rival
Compute each rival's median views
Keep posts at 3 times the median
Tag hook, format, length and first frame
List formats that win for 2 or more rivals
jobs.output: a table of breakout formats across rivals with examples
jobs.next: feeds 16 organic content and 09 creative

watch.metric: views per post on our tests of the format

jobs.job: Map the main claim and look each rival owns, and find a claim buyers care about that no rival makes
jobs.trigger: twice a year, and before a big brief

inputs.need: rival ads, home pages and product pages
inputs.from: Meta Ad Library and rival sites

inputs.need: what buyers praise in the category

steps: Write each rival's main claim and visual style in 1 line
List claims buyers praise in reviews
Mark claims no rival owns
Keep the ones we can prove
Brief the team on what to avoid and what to own
jobs.output: a claim map with 1 open claim we can prove and a do not look like list
jobs.next: feeds 10 copy and 05 brand brain positioning

watch.metric: click through on ads using the open claim

jobs.job: Find which creators carry each rival and whether it is paid, from partnership ad labels and tagged posts
steps: Pull rival partnership ads and the creators named
Pull posts tagging rivals and note paid labels
Count creators per rival and how long each runs
Mark creators who fit our avatar and do not work with a rival now
Add them to our candidate list
jobs.output: a creator map per rival and a candidate list for us
jobs.next: feeds 09 creative and 27 wild bets

watch.metric: creators contacted from the list

jobs.job: Mine 1 to 3 star reviews of each rival's top 3 products on Amazon and their site, count the complaint themes, and pick 3 we beat with proof
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then each quarter

inputs.need: our reviews on the same themes

steps: Pull up to 300 low reviews per rival product
Tag themes and count them
Check our reviews on the same themes
Pick 3 themes where we clearly win and can prove it
Write 3 ad angles and 3 page lines, naming no rival
jobs.output: a rival complaint table and 3 angles we win on with proof
jobs.next: feeds 10 copy, 09 creative and 07 product pages

watch.metric: cost per purchase on the new angles

jobs.job: Mine 4 and 5 star reviews of rivals for what buyers love that we never say, and check if we can say it truthfully
steps: Pull top reviews for rival products
Tag praise themes and the words used
Mark themes our pages and ads never mention
Check if our product does the same and we have proof
Hand true ones to copy with the buyer words
jobs.output: a list of praised benefits we under say, with proof checked
jobs.next: feeds 10 copy and 07 landing pages

watch.metric: conversion on pages that add the benefit

jobs.job: Write a battlecard per rival for support and pages: the true, checked difference, the proof link and the line to use when a shopper asks how are you different
jobs.trigger: once, then when a rival changes product, price or policy

inputs.need: chats where a rival was named

steps: Pull chats that name each rival and the questions asked
Write 3 true differences per rival with proof
Write the reply in our voice
Founder checks each line for truth
Load into support macros and FAQ
jobs.output: a battlecard per rival loaded into support
jobs.next: feeds 15 CX macros and 07 comparison blocks

watch.metric: order rate from chats that name a rival

jobs.job: Ask cart abandoners and exit visitors which brand they chose instead and why, and count wins and losses per rival
jobs.trigger: run for 4 weeks, then each quarter

inputs.need: an exit question on product and cart pages
an abandoned cart email with 1 question

steps: Add the question: did you buy something else instead, which and why
Collect answers for 4 weeks
Count rivals named and code the reasons
Name the top reason we lose to each rival
Send the top fix to the owner
jobs.output: a win and loss count per rival with the top reason
jobs.next: feeds 04 offers, 07 pages and 03-13 (battlecards)

watch.metric: answers collected

jobs.job: Show our price per unit against the rival median for each product, pack size matched, and flag any product over 15 percent above or below

inputs.need: the unit rule, like per pair

steps: Match each of our products to 3 to 5 rival products
Convert all to price per unit
Compute our index against the rival median
Flag products over 15 percent off
Check the flag against our proof and rating before any price move
jobs.output: a price index table per product with flags
jobs.next: feeds 04-15 (price moves) and 04-16 (price test)

watch.metric: price index against rival median

jobs.job: Compare our discount depth and how often we discount with each rival over 12 months, and say if we discount more while claiming to be premium

inputs.need: rival sale ads with start dates
rival site sale banners over 12 months

steps: Count our sale days and average discount for 12 months
Do the same for each rival from ads with sale words and site banners
Lay them side by side
Write the call: more, less or in line
Propose a cap if we discount more
jobs.output: a 12 month discount table vs rivals and a cap proposal
jobs.next: feeds 04-02 (discount rules)

watch.metric: share of revenue on a discount

jobs.job: Build a rival sale calendar from 12 months of ad start dates and site banners, and mark the weeks to avoid or to answer

inputs.need: rival ad start dates with sale words

steps: Pull 12 months of rival ads and find sale windows
Add site banner dates where we have them
Plot all rivals on 1 calendar
Mark weeks where 2 or more rivals run sales
Plan our own dates around them and put them on the calendar
jobs.output: a rival sale calendar with our planned dates
jobs.next: feeds 04-19 (big sale plan) and 14 email calendar

watch.metric: our revenue in weeks with rival sales

jobs.job: Count active and new ads per rival each week against ours, and track public growth signals: ad count, follower growth, review count growth
steps: Count active and new ads per brand
Compute our share of all active ads
Pull follower and review count growth for 90 days
Rank rivals by growth
Write the call: outshouted, even, or louder
jobs.output: a weekly share of voice table and a growth rank of rivals
jobs.next: feeds 11 paid social budget and 26 reports

watch.metric: our share of active ads

jobs.job: Find which rivals bid on our brand name and what share of brand searches they take, and decide how much to spend to defend it
steps: Pull auction insights for brand terms
List rivals and their impression share
Compare brand clicks from ads with organic brand clicks
Estimate orders lost if we stop bidding
Set the defend spend and send it to Google ads
jobs.output: a brand toll table with the defend spend call
jobs.next: feeds 12 Google ads brand campaigns

watch.metric: rival impression share on our brand terms

jobs.job: Track our Amazon rank against rivals on 10 core category search terms each month

inputs.need: organic and sponsored rank per term

steps: Pick 10 terms buyers use on Amazon
Pull our rank and each rival's rank per term
Compare with last month
Mark terms where we fell 5 places or more
Send listing and ad fixes to marketplaces
jobs.output: a rank table by term and brand with fall flags
jobs.next: feeds 20 marketplaces

watch.metric: average rank on core terms

new_enablers.name: Rival site watch
new_enablers.what: Crawls each rival's site and marketplace listings each week: prices, pack sizes, offers, shipping and return terms, guarantees, new products and stock outs. Keeps a dated diff so a change shows the week it happens.
inputs: rival site URLs and product pages
our product list to match against
powers: same week alerts on rival price, offer and policy changes
rival discount depth and frequency over a year
